d: Congress leader and Karnataka minister Satish Jarkiholi has backed the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Karnataka, saying the process was carried out properly and names of deceased, relocated and duplicate voters were removed. However, he raised concerns over its implementation in other states. The BJP has targeted Rahul Gandhi over the remarks, while the Supreme Court has questioned the Election Commission over the use of Form 6 for voters whose names were deleted from Delhi’s draft electoral rolls. What is the controversy about?
